# VettID

> VettID is a personal security service from The VettID Project — a member-owned
> cooperative. Each member gets a personal vault running inside a hardware-isolated
> AWS Nitro Enclave that holds their identity, credentials, secrets, connections,
> and AI agent access. The architecture is zero-knowledge: VettID's infrastructure
> only ever sees encrypted data and cannot read member content, even if compelled.

## Pages

- [Home](https://vettid.org/): what VettID does — private connections, identity
  credentials, secure secrets, AI agent access, encrypted backup, and more
- [Why VettID](https://vettid.org/why): the mission and editorial position — privacy
- https://vettid.org/use-cases: What you can do with VettID — each use case compared with how the internet works today
  as a right, identity vs. anonymity as different tools, and how the position
  shapes the architecture
- [Security](https://vettid.org/security): vulnerability disclosure policy,
  scope, severity targets, and PGP key for encrypted reports
- [Donate](https://vettid.org/donate): support the project (Bitcoin)
- [Open Source](https://vettid.org/open-source): the full stack is public on GitHub (AGPL-3.0) — enclave, apps, agent connector, infrastructure, and the LEASH proposal

## Contact

- Security reports: security@vettid.org (see https://vettid.org/.well-known/security.txt)
- General: info@vettid.org
